test_title: PYST 9: SSC JE EE- General Intelligence (Held On 11 Oct 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some pens are sharpeners.

Some sharpeners are pencils.

All pencils are erasers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some erasers are sharpeners.

II. Some pens are erasers.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
Statements:

Some pens are sharpeners.

Some sharpeners are pencils.

All pencils are erasers.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a5ba4dee7558f74301d709d4ec78f40931d69a96da24495b577c5ff289f60ad.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some erasers are sharpeners. → **Follow **(Because some sharpeners are pencils and all pencils are erasers so some erasers are sharpeners is definitely true)

II. Some pens are erasers. → **Not follow **(There is no direct relation between pens and erasers so it can be possible but not definitely true)

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only conclusion (I) follow".**
